name: The Traductor
source:
The Traductor is a creepy little story about Elias, Theo and a strange entity.

This story has its own lore with supernatural elements. It takes place in a close future on earth.

Translator are people who studied in the paranormal. They are like sleeper agents except their mission is to establish first contact with supernatural entities or extraterrestrial beings. 

[From [url=https://minimanismo.itch.io/the-traductor]Itch.io[/url]]
